"""Compressed-scale behaviour: logical sizes beyond materialisable limits."""
import json
import sys
import time

sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/project')
from main import run
from modules.byte_program import hash_bytes, MAX

MASK = (1 << 64) - 1
failures = 0
CRLF = chr(13) + chr(10)


def geometric(power, count):
    def go(k):
        if k == 0:
            return 0, 1
        if k == 1:
            return 1, power
        half, pw = go(k // 2)
        total = (half * (1 + pw)) & MASK
        full = (pw * pw) & MASK
        if k % 2:
            total = (total + full) & MASK
            full = (full * power) & MASK
        return total, full
    return go(count)[0]


def doc(definitions, cases=(), events=(), channels=(), timeout=10):
    return {'seed': 's', 'definitions': [list(row) for row in definitions],
            'timeout_ms': timeout, 'cases': list(cases), 'events': list(events),
            'channels': list(channels)}


def case(name, frames, method='GET', target='/a', host='h'):
    return {'name': name, 'frames': frames,
            'expect': {'method': method, 'target': target, 'host': host}}


def attempt(document):
    try:
        return run(document)
    except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, IndexError, UnicodeError, RecursionError):
        return {'error': 'input'}


def check(name, got, want):
    global failures
    if got != want:
        failures += 1
        print('FAIL', name)
        print('  got ', str(got)[:400])
        print('  want', str(want)[:400])
    else:
        print('ok  ', name)


# 1. multi-gigabyte Content-Length body, hashed lazily
body_len = 2_000_000_000
head = b'POST /a HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\nContent-Length: %d\r\n\r\n' % body_len
document = doc([['BODY', 'b"x" * %d' % body_len],
                ['HEAD', 'b"%s"' % head.decode('ascii').encode('unicode_escape').decode()]],
               channels=[{'name': 'edge', 'parts': [
                   {'case': None, 'data': '{{HEAD}}'},
                   {'case': None, 'data': '{{BODY}}'}]}])
start = time.time()
out = run(document)
elapsed = time.time() - start
record = out['channels'][0]['requests'][0]
body_hash = 121 * geometric(257, body_len) & MASK
check('huge length body (%.2fs)' % elapsed,
      (out['channels'][0]['error'], record['framing'], record['body']['n'], record['body']['h']),
      (None, 'length', body_len, '%016x' % body_hash))
check('huge channel bytes n', out['channels'][0]['bytes']['n'], len(head) + body_len)
check('committed', out['channels'][0]['committed'], [0, 1])
check('start/end', (record['start'], record['end']), (0, len(head) + body_len))

# 2. huge chunked body across owner boundaries
chunk = 500_000_000
size_line = format(chunk, 'x').encode() + b'\r\n'
head = b'POST /a HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n'
tail = b'0\r\nX: y\r\n\r\n'
document = doc([['CH', 'b"y" * %d' % chunk],
                ['HDR', 'b"%s"' % head.decode('ascii').encode('unicode_escape').decode()]],
               cases=[case('copper', [{'Type': 'headers', 'End_Stream': True,
                                       'data_to_transfered': [[':method', 'POST']]}])],
               channels=[{'name': 'edge', 'parts': [
                   {'case': 'copper', 'data': '{{HDR}}'},
                   {'case': None, 'data': size_line.decode()},
                   {'case': 'copper', 'data': '{{CH}}'},
                   {'case': None, 'data': CRLF},
                   {'case': None, 'data': size_line.decode()},
                   {'case': 'copper', 'data': '{{CH}}'},
                   {'case': None, 'data': CRLF},
                   {'case': 'copper', 'data': tail.decode()}]}])
start = time.time()
out = run(document)
row = out['channels'][0]
record = row['requests'][0]
yhash = (122 * geometric(257, chunk)) & MASK
digest = (yhash * pow(257, chunk, 1 << 64) + yhash) & MASK
check('huge chunked body (%.2fs)' % (time.time() - start),
      (record['framing'], record['body']['n'], record['body']['h'], record['trailers']['n']),
      ('chunked', chunk * 2, '%016x' % digest, 26))
check('chunked owners', record['owners'],
      [['copper', len(head) + 2 * chunk + len(tail)], [None, 2 * len(size_line) + 4]])
check('chunked flags', record['flags'], ['identity', 'mixed_owner'])
check('chunked error', row['error'], None)
check('chunked committed', row['committed'], [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1])
check('chunked host/method', (record['host'], record['host_count'], record['method']['n']),
      ({'n': 1, 'h': '%016x' % hash_bytes(b'h')}, 1, 4))
check('chunked case origin', (out['cases'][0]['origin_count'], out['cases'][0]['flags']),
      (1, ['identity', 'mixed_origin']))

# 3. huge line without LF is a syntax error, quickly
document = doc([['NOISE', 'b"z" * %d' % (10 ** 12)]],
               channels=[{'name': 'edge', 'parts': [{'case': None, 'data': '{{NOISE}}'}]}])
start = time.time()
out = run(document)
check('huge unterminated line (%.2fs)' % (time.time() - start),
      (out['channels'][0]['error'], out['channels'][0]['bytes']['n']),
      ({'kind': 'syntax', 'offset': 0}, 10 ** 12))

# 4. exact line limit
for extra, want in ((0, None), (1, {'kind': 'syntax', 'offset': 0})):
    document = doc([['L', 'b"A" * %d' % (8189 + extra)]],
                   channels=[{'name': 'e', 'parts': [
                       {'case': None, 'data': '{{b"GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nX: " + L}}'},
                       {'case': None, 'data': CRLF * 2}]}])
    out = run(document)
    check('line limit %d' % (8192 + extra), out['channels'][0]['error'], want)
    if want is None:
        check('line limit request', (len(out['channels'][0]['requests']),
                                     out['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['end']),
              (1, 16 + 8192 + 2 + 2))

# 5. huge datagram receipt
document = doc([['G', 'b"q" * %d' % (3 * 10 ** 9)]],
               cases=[case('copper', [{'Type': 'datagram', 'data_to_transfered': '{{G}}'}])])
out = run(document)
row = out['cases'][0]
check('huge datagram receipt',
      (row['payload_bytes'], row['sent']['n'], row['frames'], row['request_frames'],
       row['state'], row['at']),
      (3 * 10 ** 9, 8 + 4 + 1 + 8 + 3 * 10 ** 9 + 1, 1, 0, 'timeout', 10))

# 6. repeat limits
check('oversized repeat', attempt(doc([['X', 'b"ab" * %d' % ((MAX // 2) + 1)]])),
      {'error': 'input'})
out = attempt(doc([['X', 'b"ab" * %d' % (MAX // 2)]],
                  channels=[{'name': 'e', 'parts': [{'case': None, 'data': '{{X}}'}]}]))
check('max size accepted', out['channels'][0]['bytes']['n'], (MAX // 2) * 2)
check('max size error', out['channels'][0]['error'], {'kind': 'syntax', 'offset': 0})
out = attempt(doc([['X', 'b"a" * %d' % MAX]],
                  channels=[{'name': 'e', 'parts': [{'case': None, 'data': '{{X}}'}]}]))
check('exact max length', out['channels'][0]['bytes']['n'], MAX)

print('big: %d failures' % failures)
PYEOF
